There is a place for you

Not everyone cooks, and that is fine. Parish fellowship rests on a great many small acts of service, most of which take an hour and none of which need an introduction.

All parish ministries →
Welcome ministry
Greet visitors in the narthex and help newcomers feel at home. Greeters serve on Sunday mornings today; a trained welcome ministry is one of the proposals in this draft.
Proposed
Setup & cleanup
Help lay out the parish hall before a meal, or clear away afterwards. Half an hour, and it is the half nobody sees.
Proposed
Kids' Corner
Keep the activity supplies in order and prepare an occasional feast-day or saint's-day activity. This is the ministry the corner described under the Agape Meal would need in order to exist.
Proposed
Parish events
Feast-day celebrations, the Greek Festival and special parish gatherings — every one of them is put on by parishioners.
Charitable outreach
Serving our neighbours and the wider community. Most of it happens through the Ladies' Philoptochos Society.
Missions
Supporting Orthodox mission work at home and abroad. Nothing is organised at parish level yet.
Proposed
Proposed — for Fr. John's review

Four of the six above do not exist today. They are shown as proposals rather than as sign-up links, because a link to a ministry nobody runs yet costs the person who follows it more than the blank space would. Each becomes a real link the moment the parish decides who leads it.
